place: Thenzawl Handloom Town and Tuirihiau Falls
text: Thenzawl is a census town in Serchhip district in the Indian state of Mizoram. It is a center for the traditional Mizo handloom industry.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
